args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with elevated error rate (0.18). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), which was unhealthy with an elevated error rate (0.18).
2. **Identified target**: From the deployment history, the most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were both healthy; v2.3.1 was unhealthy).
3. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`rolled_out`).
4. **Opened incident**: Created a SEV2 incident for checkout-api describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.
5. **Verified**: Confirmed checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with a normal error rate (0.002).
